signIn.title: Log in
signIn.subtitle: Log in to pick up where your receipts left off.

signUp.termsNotice: By creating an account you agree to Mataresit’s terms and privacy notice.

callback.errorDescription: There was a problem processing your authentication. Please try again.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter the email on your account and we’ll send a link to set a new password.
forgotPassword.subtitleSent: Check your email for a password reset link.
forgotPassword.success: Password reset link sent to your email
forgotPassword.error: Failed to send reset link. Please try again.

resetPassword.title: Set a new password
resetPassword.subtitle: Choose a new password for your account. You’ll be signed out after it’s saved.
resetPassword.requirements: Password must be at least 6 characters long.
resetPassword.recoveryNote: This is a one-time process for account recovery. After setting a new password, you’ll be signed out and can log in with your new password.
resetPassword.error: Failed to update password. Please try again.

verification.title: Verify Email
verification.subtitle: Check your email for a verification link

logout.title: Sign Out
logout.message: Are you sure you want to sign out?

validation.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 6 characters

toasts.passwordResetDescription: Please set a new password for your account.
toasts.passwordUpdatedDescription: Your password has been successfully updated. You will be signed out and can now log in with your new password.

errors.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 6 characters
errors.emailInvalid: Please enter a valid email address
errors.termsRequired: You must agree to the terms and conditions
errors.networkError: Network error. Please check your connection.
errors.serverError: Server error. Please try again later.
errors.userExists: An account with this email already exists
errors.userNotFound: No account found with this email

branding.tagline: Smart receipt management for modern teams
branding.feature1Desc: Drop a scan and pull the merchant, totals and line items.
branding.feature2Desc: Approve or flag claims with a dated trail of who did what.
branding.feature3Desc: See totals by category and month, ready to export.
branding.feature4Desc: Receipts live with your workspace, not in a shared drive or an inbox.
